topics.label: Course Introduction and Lecture Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The opening framing welcomes students to the course, outlines the scope of the lecture series, and presents the session's key learning outcomes.

topics.label: Cancer as a Multistep Disruption of Differentiation and Tissue Organization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through accumulated genetic and epigenetic alterations that disrupt normal cellular differentiation, three-dimensional tissue architecture, and growth control.

topics.label: Tumor Invasion, Metastasis, and Benign-Malignant Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the defining features of benign and malignant tumors, focusing on tissue invasion, metastatic dissemination, and the stepwise histological progression from precursor lesions to invasive disease.

topics.label: Principles and Exceptions of Tumor Nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the standard rules, suffixes, and clinical exceptions used to classify and name benign and malignant neoplasms across different tissue origins.

topics.label: Pathophysiological Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how primary and metastatic tumors cause systemic illness, functional organ impairment, and death through local compression, tissue destruction, and metabolic disruption.

topics.label: Cancer Incidence in Human Tissues and Across Animal Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the epidemiological frequency of different tumor types across human tissues and compare their occurrence throughout diverse multicellular animal taxa.

topics.label: Clinical Presentation and Cancer Screening Strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore early clinical signs of cancer and evaluate the methods, efficacy, and limitations of population screening across different anatomical sites.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Practical Session Preview
topics.groupedBecause: The closing framing recaps the session's learning outcomes and provides logistical instructions for upcoming practical sessions and lectures.
